Overview

Bloemfontein is a city in Free State with a population of 556,000. The judicial capital and Rose City, known for its parks, historic architecture, and central location. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
